verdict.rationale: Missive documents a REST API, and its endpoint reference is available as raw Markdown plus an llms.txt index. That is human-readable reference documentation, not a machine-readable API spec. The evidence explicitly states no OpenAPI spec is documented, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
